mapper.insert: insert into basket_captain_grant_log ( grant_id, member_id, player_id, team_id, season_id, action_type, before_status, after_status, payment_confirmed, payment_reference, grant_time, expire_time, revoke_time, operator_id, operator_name, operator_type, reason, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values ( #{grantId}, #{memberId}, #{playerId}, #{teamId}, #{seasonId}, #{actionType}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{paymentConfirmed}, #{paymentReference}, #{grantTime}, #{expireTime}, #{revokeTime}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorType}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete} )
mapper.select: select l.id, l.grant_id as grantId, l.member_id as memberId, l.player_id as playerId, l.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, l.season_id as seasonId, coalesce(s.display_title, s.season_name) as seasonName, tm.series_name as tournamentName, coalesce(nullif(trim(tm.series_name), ''), coalesce(s.display_title, s.season_name)) as eventName, l.action_type as actionType, l.before_status as beforeStatus, l.after_status as afterStatus, l.payment_confirmed as paymentConfirmed, l.payment_reference as paymentReference, l.grant_time as grantTime, l.expire_time as expireTime, l.revoke_time as revokeTime, l.operator_id as operatorId, l.operator_name as operatorName, l.operator_type as operatorType, l.reason, l.remark, l.create_time as createTime from basket_captain_grant_log l left join basket_season s on s.id = l.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_series tm on tm.id = s.series_id and tm.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = l.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 where l.grant_id = #{grantId} and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.id desc
